items.meaning: SMTP 服务扩展的名称，也是 EHLO 关键字值，无参数。
用于告知 SMTP 客户端服务器当前能够协商使用 TLS 的关键字，无参数。
新的 SMTP 命令，格式为 STARTTLS 且无参数。
公开引用的 SMTP 服务器不得要求使用 STARTTLS 扩展才能本地投递邮件。
items.constraint: MUST NOT require use of the STARTTLS extension in order to deliver mail locally
items.action: require use of the STARTTLS extension in order to deliver mail locally

items.meaning: 非公开引用的 SMTP 服务器若要求客户端在接受任何命令前进行 TLS 协商，则应对除 NOOP、EHLO、STARTTLS、QUIT 外的每个命令返回 530 回复码。
items.constraint: SHOULD return the reply code 530 to every command other than NOOP, EHLO, STARTTLS, or QUIT
items.object: every command other than NOOP, EHLO, STARTTLS, or QUIT
items.condition: A SMTP server that is not publicly referenced may choose to require that the client perform a TLS negotiation before accepting any commands
items.exception: other than NOOP, EHLO, STARTTLS, or QUIT

items.meaning: 收到 STARTTLS 命令的 220 响应后，客户端必须在发出任何其他 SMTP 命令前开始 TLS 协商。
items.constraint: MUST start the TLS negotiation before giving any other SMTP commands
items.condition: After receiving a 220 response to a STARTTLS command

items.meaning: 若客户端发出 STARTTLS 后发现某故障阻止其实际开始 TLS 握手，则应中止连接。
items.condition: after having issued the STARTTLS command, the client finds out that some failure prevents it from actually starting a TLS handshake

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后，双方必须立即根据所获得认证与隐私决定是否继续。
items.constraint: MUST immediately decide whether or not to continue based on the authentication and privacy achieved
items.action: decide whether or not to continue based on the authentication and privacy achieved
items.condition: After the TLS handshake has been completed

items.meaning: 若客户端认为认证或隐私级别不足以继续，应在 TLS 协商完成后立即发出 SMTP QUIT 命令。
items.constraint: SHOULD issue an SMTP QUIT command immediately after the TLS negotiation is complete
items.condition: If the SMTP client decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: 若服务器认为认证或隐私级别不足以继续，应对客户端除 QUIT 外的每个 SMTP 命令回复 554 回复码。
items.constraint: SHOULD reply to every SMTP command from the client (other than a QUIT command) with the 554 reply code
items.object: every SMTP command from the client (other than a QUIT command)
items.condition: If the SMTP server decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后 SMTP 协议重置为初始状态，服务器必须丢弃从客户端获得的、非来自 TLS 协商本身的知识。
items.constraint: MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the client ... which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.action: discard any knowledge obtained from the client
items.condition: Upon completion of the TLS handshake
items.exception: which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself

items.meaning: 客户端必须丢弃从服务器获得的、非来自 TLS 协商本身的知识。
items.constraint: MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the server ... which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.action: discard any knowledge obtained from the server
items.exception: which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself

items.meaning: 客户端应在成功 TLS 协商后把 EHLO 命令作为第一条命令发送。
items.constraint: SHOULD send an EHLO command as the first command after a successful TLS negotiation

items.meaning: TLS 握手后 EHLO 返回的 SMTP 服务扩展列表可能与握手前不同。
客户端和服务器都必须知道是否存在活动的 TLS 会话。
items.constraint: MUST know if there is a TLS session active
items.action: know if there is a TLS session active
items.object: whether a TLS session is active

items.meaning: 若 TLS 会话已处于活动状态，客户端不得尝试启动 TLS 会话。
items.constraint: MUST NOT attempt to start a TLS session if a TLS session is already active
items.action: attempt to start a TLS session
items.condition: if a TLS session is already active

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后，服务器不得在响应 EHLO 命令时返回 STARTTLS 扩展。
items.constraint: MUST NOT return the STARTTLS extension in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed
items.action: return the STARTTLS extension in response to an EHLO command
items.condition: received after a TLS handshake has completed

items.meaning: 为防御中间人攻击，客户端和服务器必须能够被配置为在传输邮件前要求对选定主机进行成功且使用适当密码套件的 TLS 协商。
items.constraint: MUST be able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts before messages can be successfully transferred
items.action: be able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts
items.object: successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts
items.condition: In order to defend against such attacks

items.meaning: 还应提供在可能时使用 TLS 的附加选项。
items.action: provide the additional option of using TLS when possible
items.object: additional option of using TLS when possible

items.meaning: 实现可提供记录与某对端通信时使用了 TLS 并在后续会话未使用时产生警告的能力。
items.constraint: MAY provide the ability to record that TLS was used in communicating with a given peer and generating a warning if it is not used in a later session
items.action: provide the ability to record that TLS was used ... and generating a warning if it is not used in a later session
items.object: recording TLS usage and warning capability

items.meaning: 客户端和服务器必须在 TLS 握手完成时丢弃握手开始前获得的所有知识。
items.constraint: MUST discard any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake upon completion of the TLS handshake
items.action: discard any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake
items.object: knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake
items.condition: upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: SASL EXTERNAL 机制可与 STARTTLS 命令结合使用以提供授权身份。
items.constraint: MAY be used in conjunction with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity
items.action: be used in conjunction with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity
